global_style.description: Global style template (VidRush theme parity). One choice drives script pacing, VO tone, palette/typography, transitions, B-roll mood. Legacy names accepted as aliases.

edit_style.description: DEPRECATED — use global_style. Kept so old timelines validate; resolved through the legacy alias map.

asset_mode.description: The asset route for the whole video (Path A/B/C). 'auto' (default) = the pipeline auto-fills: image beats are generated via ModelScope (Z-Image photoreal/bilingual by default, Krea-2-Turbo for stylized/LoRA beats), video beats go to the stock search. 'stock' = pull footage from Pexels/Pixabay per scene keyword. 'generated' = you drop AI-generated stills/clips into assets/in/ per scene (image gen, or image+video gen); the pipeline prints the 04/05 prompt for any scene it's missing. A scene may override via broll.source.

vo_config.description: Path to VO provider config (default: pipeline/config/vo.json)

total_sec.description: RESOLVED (orchestrator): expected program duration on the assembled-picture clock (sum of scene durations minus xfade overlaps). Written by stage_retime_to_vo; not authored by the director.

sfx_volume.description: Default per-scene SFX level (0..1) before the VO duck. Director overrides per scene.

layout.description: Editorial layout variant (content scenes). Director's choice.

energy.description: Director's pacing choice. low=still/quiet, mid=default, high=kinetic accent (hook/turn/reveal only).

placement.description: Content placement intent — where text/content anchors (rule-of-thirds). Director's choice.

shake.description: Impact shake intensity 0..1. 0/absent = off. Director opts in ONLY for genuine impact beats.

shake_at.description: Frame the impact shake starts on (default 0 = scene opening beat).

shake_dir.description: Dominant direction of the impact kick (Phase 8, P4). x=horizontal hit (default), y=vertical, diag=both. Director intent; the style renders it into motion.

arc_position.description: Genre-arc beat this scene serves (context/evidence/reveal/…) — informational, from genreArcs.

beats.description: Director beat-choreography overrides (Phase 8, P0): named beat → SECONDS from scene start. Only set the beats you move; the rest keep style defaults. Beat names per scene type are documented in skills/02_director.md. Seconds = editorial intent; the scene renders them into frames+easing.

tempo.description: Director rhythm multiplier for this scene (default 1). >1 slower/heavier, <1 tighter. Scales the style's default beat timing; explicit `beats` still win.

transition_out.description: Director's cut intent OUT of this scene (Phase 8, P2). hard=instant cut, style=the style's default xfade, dissolve/dip=soften, whip=act-break energy. Never a raw xfade name — placement is yours, the type is the style's.

transition_note.description: One-sentence justification for a non-default transition_out (the 'because ___').

sfx.description: Director opt-in sound effect for THIS scene (Phase 8, P6): a filename in pipeline/assets/sfx/ (paper.wav, whoosh.wav, hit.wav). Motivated by the beat — a document rustle, a transition whoosh, an impact hit — never decoration. Placed at scene start, ducked under VO. Rarity: >2 per video warns.

sfx_volume.description: This scene's SFX level (0..1) before the VO duck. Overrides the timeline default.

grade_override.description: Per-scene grade intent (Phase 8, P7): signpost era/mood for THIS scene only, mapped onto the style palette. archival=old footage, clean=present-day, noir=hard crime, sepia=warm history, halftone=print/document.

signature.description: Director opt-in signature move (Phase 8, P5) — the genre's one recognizable move, fired only when you call it. Style-capped; minimalist/standard forbid most. glitch_at=frame of the crime twist glitch; archival=0..1 scratch/dust era overlay (history). Rarity enforced: a move used >1× gets a validator warning.

word_times.description: VO→visual sync (Phase 8, P1): [[word, t_seconds], ...] relative to scene start, filled by the orchestrator from the VO provider (native timings or prosody estimate). Scenes land text/punch/shake on the spoken syllables. Not authored by the director.

photo_move.description: Director's ken-burns move for the photo base (FFmpeg side). in=push toward subject, out=release, left/right/up/down=pan. Motivated by the beat: push-in for intimacy/turn, out for resolve, pan to follow action.

parallax.description: Director opt-in: does this beat earn the 2-plane depth move? Off for quiet/VO-carrying beats, on for reveals/turns. Default true (most beats benefit).

vo_audio.description: RESOLVED: path to the synthesized VO clip for this scene (stage_vo).

vo_duration.description: RESOLVED: measured VO length in seconds; drives scene retiming.

vo_tail.description: Padding after measured VO before the cut (default 0.5s). Director may tune.

needs_manual_asset.description: RESOLVED: asset resolution fell back to a style plate; drop a manual file at pipeline/assets/in/.

resolved_asset_kind.description: RESOLVED (orchestrator): provenance that drives the footage-type router. image/plate → Remotion full theme; video → FFmpeg minimal edit. Never inferred from file extension.

resolved_segments.description: RESOLVED: ordered video source segments that fill this scene's measured duration (fetch-to-cover, trim-to-fit).

render_route.description: RESOLVED: derived from resolved_asset_kind (remotion|ffmpeg); persisted for diagnostics, not authored.

props.description: Scene-type-specific Remotion props. Must include bg_image or bg_video.

gen_kind.description: Path B only: what to drop in assets/in/ — image (still, looped), image_video (still + motion clip), or video (motion clip). Drives the printed prompt (04 image / 05 video).

local_path.description: If source=local/manual/generated, path relative to assets/in/
